title: Mochizuki Honami — Figuring Out What I Can Do〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Figuring Out What I Can Do（4★）

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's already this late...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We did spend a lot of time going through all the lyrics Ichi came up with♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you gave me some nice suggestions, so I'll take it from here and do what I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure about this, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you feel stuck, you can tell us, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I am. Thanks. Anyway, I'll be...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot.
Honami, here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is this...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's that list of flowers you asked me to put together the other day. They should all be in bloom now, so I'm sure they'll make for great gifts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you so much!
I know you're trying to focus on writing those lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, actually, it gave me a chance to take a breather.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? What's this? A list of flowers?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You know how I've been doing some work as a housekeeper?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Although I'm not required to or anything, for this one place, I've been bringing over flowers from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then I was asked to make it a part of my work order.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So they asked you to make it official and you needed some help with that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. It'd been a while since I last looked up what sort of meaning each flower holds, so it was pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I may even be able to use them in our lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that'd be nice! Your love of flowers is bound to give you some good ideas for a song♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I should get home and work on my lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for staying back so late with me. See you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika's doing her best, but it's clear that she's having a tough time with this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: To be fair, I stumbled around in the dark for a while until you and Rin gave me hints I needed, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That's right. Saki went through quite a lot while writing this song for us.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (My mind knows that but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do for Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Maybe Ms. Yoisaki knows...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's a composer in her own right and has a dedicated lyricist in her group. She might be able to answer my question.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can ask her and...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing. I was just trying to think up some ideas.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
How can we help Ichi get through this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I'm still only supposed to go to her house for work.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We've grown much closer, but it's probably not very professional to take my personal problems into her home...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Right, that would be incredibly rude of me, so I should avoid doing that to her!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I should come up with a way to help Ichika on my own!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm?
Did you come up with something, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You looked like you were ready to do something just now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I was...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, I didn't exactly come up with a good idea or anything, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've decided that I need to find something that I personally can do to help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. Instead of crying over spilled milk, we should think about what we can do about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna do that too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Okay! I'll start by listening to some music and learning more about how lyrics are written.)
